newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says no decision yet on PC output in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Sony says no decision yet on PC output in U.S..

text.p: Sony Corp said on Friday that it has not yet decided whether to produce its personal computers in the United States.
A Sony spokesman also said that the company does not plan at this point to end an original equipment manufacturing deal with Intel Corp for its desk-top PCs.
The business daily Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun reported on Friday that Sony would produce PCs at its San Diego factory in the United States and would end the OEM deal with Intel.
Intel makes Sony's desktop PCs, which were launched in the U.S. market in September 1996.
Sony plans to introduce notebook-sized PCs in July in the United States and Japan, the spokesman said. Most of the production process for the notebook PCs will be conducted in Japan, he said.
